recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖（非形態圖）：在 blast gate 中，CD34 表現由陰性到中等陽性呈連續分布，CD123 多為弱陽性至陰性，未見 CD123 強陽性族群。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on blasts: CD34-PC7 (x-axis) versus CD123-APC (y-axis)
CD34 expression heterogeneous, forming a continuum from negative to moderate
CD123 largely dim to negative across the population
No discrete CD123-bright population identified within the gate
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the gated blast population shows heterogeneous CD34 expression, with a CD34-negative subset merging into a CD34-dim-to-moderate subset, and uniformly dim-to-negative CD123. A discrete CD123-bright population is not present within this gate. Partial CD34 expression on blasts is common in myeloid neoplasms, and the absence of a CD123-bright population argues against blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; note that GATA2 deficiency is characteristically associated with loss of plasmacytoid dendritic cells, which should be assessed on the ungated plot.
